marta: Heads up — planning a KMS key rewrap for customer data next week. Need alignment on RBAC changes, audit fields, and abort criteria if rewrap causes errors. AWS/GCP/Azure all in scope. Thoughts?

josh: Can we narrow scope to S3-encrypted blobs first? I want to avoid rewrapping embeddings in DB until after canary.

anika: Agree. Canary plan: 1% of accounts in staging -> 1 host in prod -> 10 hosts. Need logs to include `original_key_id` and `new_key_id` for every rewrap.

lee: RBAC notes: we'll need `kms:ReEncrypt*` / `kms:Encrypt` / `kms:Decrypt` on the rewrap role. For AWS the role must be assumable via `sts:AssumeRole`. For GCP the service account needs `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt` + `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt`. I'll confirm exact perms.

marta: I'll draft perms. Also need audit logging retention and a config to stream rewrap ops to SecLog. Who owns the sink? @sre-oncall?

sre-oncall: SRE will route to log-sink. Please add structured fields: `rewrap.batch_id`, `rewrap.object_id`, `rewrap.status`. Important: redact any plaintext or PII. Do NOT log raw ciphertext bodies.

anika: Vuln triage angle: if rewrap hits KMS throttling or crypto errors, we should pause and serve reads using the original KEK until we fix. Proposed abort criteria: >0.5% failed rewraps per minute for 5 consecutive minutes OR >500 failed ops in any rolling 1h window.

josh: Also add latency abort: p95 read latency spike >50% for >10m -> pause job and alert.

sec-bot: Note: current envelope format is `enc_v=1` (header). New rewrap will emit `enc_v=2` with additional `kek_id`. Decoder must accept both. Add field `enc_version` to logs.

marta: Good call. Auto-rotate vs manual rewrap question: proposal -> keep automatic CMK rotation enabled for long-term key hygiene but do MANUAL rewrap for ciphertext materials. Auto CMK rotation doesn't re-encrypt existing ciphertext; we need the rewrap job for that.

lee: For Azure Key Vault and GCP, in-place key rotation commands don't rewrap either. We'll implement a unified worker that pulls objects, calls KMS re-encrypt API (or SDK), writes back new envelope. Same logic across clouds.

anika: Observability: metrics we need: `rewrap.duration_ms` (histogram), `rewrap.attempts_total`, `rewrap.failures_total`, `rewrap.success_rate` (derived). Create alert: success_rate < 99.5% for 10m -> SEV-2.

josh: Quick AWS CLI snippet for rewrap reference: ```aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj.enc --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/abcd-1234 > new_blob.enc```

marta: Thanks. Rollout/team owners: @lee owns RBAC and gating. @josh owns rewrap worker autoscaling + backpressure. @anika owns metrics/alerts + vuln triage doc. @sre-oncall owns logs sink and runbook page.

deploy-bot: deploy 2045678920: rewrap-worker v1.2 queued to staging.

marta: :thumbsup: Draft checklist (I'll add to runbook):
- Stage: run rewrap on non-prod subset, verify decoder accepts `enc_v=1` + `enc_v=2`.
- Canary: 100 objects in prod namespace -> check success_rate, latency, and log fields.
- Scale: ramp to 1% accounts for 24h. Watch derived alerts.
- Full run: stagger by region and customer tier, run overnight windows.
- Abort: follow abort criteria, then revert writes for the last batch and open incident.
- Post-run: run consistency check to ensure decrypted checksum matches pre-rewrap.

marta: Adding link to runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rewrap-2045 (will push after review).

anika: I'll write the vuln triage checklist: add play to check for cryptographic exceptions, expired key versions, and missing `GetPublicKey` perms.

josh: One more ops detail: rewrap workers must honor KMS QPS limits. Add token-bucket and jitter, exponential backoff for `ThrottlingException`.

lee: I'll produce RBAC PR with minimal perms and gating policy. Expect draft by EOD.

marta: Perfect. If no objections, I'll formalize checklist and schedule staging job Thu.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll prep the sink and retention policy.

marta: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the playbook PR.
